chromePath.description: Absolute path of Chrome or Chromium; found automatically when absent.

profileRoot.description: Folder for the lasting agent profile; default ~/.marshal/browser/profiles.

headed.description: Show the agent profile's window (default: only on Linux with a DISPLAY).

artifactDir.description: Where screenshots and videos are saved; default <tmp>/marshal-browser/artifacts.

vision.description: Attach the marked screenshot to each decision (default true).

keepStepShots.description: Also save every step's marked screenshot as a task artifact (default false).

planLength.description: Longest plan one decision may return: the step also asks for up to this many actions in order, each re-checked on a fresh snapshot and through every guard before it is taken (default 6; 1 = one action per decision).

valuePointers.description: Read flat want.data values (strings, numbers) from the page lines the confirming decision points at, instead of a separate extract call (default true).

speculativeExtract.description: Start the want.data extract beside a decision that is likely the last, instead of after it; an unused one is dropped (default true).

userVision.description: Attach a screenshot to decisions on the person's own Chrome (default false: text only, so no picture of their pages goes to the model provider).

axHelperPath.description: Absolute path of marshal-ax-helper (the app backend); default dist/native.

ocrHelperPath.description: Absolute path of marshal-ocr-helper (OCR for apps with thin Accessibility); default dist/native.

ffmpegPath.description: ffmpeg for session videos; otherwise MARSHAL_BROWSER_FFMPEG, the system's, or the one @marshal/hyperframes pins.

bridgePort.description: Loopback port of the bridge the person's Chrome (the carried Marley Chrome extension) connects to. Default 17373; the extension's popup must name the same address.

chromeExtensionDir.description: Absolute folder the carried Marley Chrome extension is copied to at activation, for Load unpacked; it outlives updates of this package. Default ~/.marshal/browser/chrome-extension.

agentGuidance.purpose: One browser for agents: a Chrome it starts (agent, visitor, offline profiles), the person's own Chrome (on:"user") or a native macOS app via Accessibility (on:"app"). A task is a code loop; each step is one marshal.models.decide call.
agentGuidance.when: browser.task: 'open X and get me Y' or a few UI steps; browser.ask: questions about one page; browser.session.*: drive it yourself (act, wait, read, evaluate, log, dialog). A goal that needs the person's own login runs on:"user"; if browser.status says it is not paired, give them its setup steps.
agentGuidance.recipe: browser.task {goal, startUrl, want: {data: <JSON schema>, text, screenshot}, values: {name: text to type}} returns {status, data, text, artifacts, trace}. On needs_owner, needs_input or low_confidence, read reason, candidates and the screenshot, then decide yourself.
agentGuidance.boundaries: Task: types only caller values; stops in code on leaving its site, off-site forms/links, OAuth/checkout/payment pages, private addresses, app signals. No key or text reaches a password field. evaluate: managed Chrome only. Own Chrome: background tabs, text-only. Apps: no real input by default.
